This summer changes everything.

In Farming Camp, you’re not just growing crops, you’re growing into yourself. Our Story Trailer introduces a heartfelt journey about ambition, friendship, and discovering where you truly belong.

At a cozy camp filled with charming pixel-art landscapes and lovable characters, one determined young farmer sets out to prove they have what it takes. Along the way, bonds are formed, rivalries spark, and quiet moments shape a life-changing summer.

Plant roots. Build friendships. Find your place. 🌱

description:
Legacy of Kain: Ascendance is here! A fast, retro action platformer built around vertical movement, fluid combat, and skill-driven play. Step into a dark fantasy world brought to life through beautifully crafted pixel art and animated cutscenes.

Chain vicious melee strikes, evasive dashes, and supernatural attacks as combat flows seamlessly into traversal and environmental puzzles. Experience multiple perspectives across Nosgoth’s history.
Featuring an original score by Celldweller and returning voice talent from the Legacy of Kain series, Ascendance delivers a new chapter forged in legacy and driven by momentum.

You'll wall-jump past buzz saws, crumbling caves, and flaming forests, dying a million times along the way - IN (you guessed it) 3D. With old-school difficulty, twitchy reflexes, epic bosses, and loads of secrets, it’s Meat Boy like never before - IN (say it with me!) 3D!
